programs.title: Wheeler Dealers: Chopped
programs.desc: Mike Brewer and mechanic Edd China purchase old, used cars, which they resell at a profit after renovation.Not much worth the old stuff, they suddenly become automotive gems.

programs.title: Road absurdities 6
programs.desc: You cannot turn left from the left turn lane - such inconsistent markings can be found in Warsaw, where it is also difficult not to notice sound-absorbing screens costing over PLN 600,000.PLN separating traffic lanes.Nearly 100 thousandPLN was spent on investing in pedestrian crossing signals in Osięciny - currently they are covered with black bags.Kamil and Krzysiek will also visit Podolszyn Nowy to see a wrongly placed sign informing about the traffic organization at the intersection, and in Łódź they will see non-working lamps on a forest road costing nearly PLN 150,000 and see a sign that exempts customers and suppliers from the laws of physics on a steep driveway.

programs.title: Road absurdities 6
programs.desc: Are we waiting for a dead body?" - this is the rhetorical question Kamil and Krzysiek will come across in Inowrocław, right next to something that resembles a roundabout, although it is not a roundabout at all. In the same city we will also find an unfinished investment for PLN 5 million - only 300 meters are left to connect two national roads. We will also examine the issue of the traffic lights in Grudziądz, which was activated for a few days and then turned off.Syrenka S201 will also visit Ksawerów, where on the sidewalk you can encounter... ropes supporting a pole.In Koziegłowy, our attention will be drawn to the exit from a one-way road straight to a head-on collision, in Gliwice - a closed sidewalk, and in Zawiercie - an extremely mysterious combination of three signs.

programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: Rajmund Kapustka from specialist roadside assistance is faced with the task of removing an old construction crane from the Katowice highway.The problem is that the vehicle has no handle.Connecting it to the tow in a way that allows for free maneuvering is quite a challenge.Tomek, Ania and Mateusz, carrying a concrete pump to Hamburg, face low viaducts.Just before the Polish-German border, there is also a problem with travel permits.Viewers can also follow the passage of a convoy with a 200-ton reactor through Klaipėda.The team led by Makuwa discovers that even such a heavy load is susceptible to shifting.
